open_questions.detail: Kitchen hours, pizzeria address, delivery phone, email, and social profile links in the footer (nodes 6:151–6:169, 6:144) are plain static text/vectors in the Figma frame, with no CMS field, API, or config binding indicated anywhere in the file. This is exactly the content the story name ('footer business info') calls out, so how it is sourced materially changes the component design.
open_questions.arc_assumption: Modeled FooterInfoColumn, FooterScheduleRow, FooterAddressBlock, FooterContactLines and SocialRow as presentational components driven entirely by props, and mapped each 1:1 to the literal copy shown in the frame (e.g. 'Monday - Thursday' / '12:00 PM - 10:00 PM' as separate hardcoded rows) rather than by a data model that a non-engineer could edit.

options.label: Static props/constants — footer copy ships hardcoded in code, matching the Figma text exactly
CMS/admin-configurable — hours, address, contact info and social links are fetched from a backend so restaurant staff can update them without a deploy

open_questions.detail: All icons (fire-extinguisher, truck, star, shield, compass, plus, arrow-right, shopping-cart, instagram, facebook, twitter) are raw Figma VECTOR paths, not exported bitmap assets. Their layer names match an existing open-source icon set (Lucide) exactly.
open_questions.arc_assumption: Assumed these should be implemented with the Lucide icon set (matching names 1:1) via the shared Icon component, rather than hand-tracing each vector's path data into custom SVGs.

open_questions.detail: 'Privacy Policy' and 'Delivery Terms' (nodes 6:174, 6:175) are styled as links but no destination page/URL is defined in the design.
open_questions.arc_assumption: Implemented FooterLegalLinks as anchors with placeholder href="#" until real destination pages/URLs exist.

open_questions.detail: The Instagram/Facebook/Twitter icon buttons in the footer (6:145, 6:147, 6:149) have no attached profile URLs in the Figma file.
open_questions.arc_assumption: Modeled href as a required prop on SocialIconButton and used a placeholder '#' until real profile URLs are supplied.

open_questions.detail: The frame is a single fixed 1440px desktop composition; no tablet or mobile variant of the 3-column footer (brand / kitchen hours / location) is provided anywhere in the file.
open_questions.arc_assumption: Assumed the 3 footer columns stack vertically below a standard tablet breakpoint, and that the bottom bar's copyright/legal-links row stacks to two centered lines on narrow viewports.

open_questions.detail: Footer links (legal links, social icons) and header nav items only show a single static visual state in the frame; no hover, focus-visible, or pressed state is drawn for any interactive element.
open_questions.arc_assumption: Assumed conventional web affordances: opacity/underline shift on link hover, and a visible focus ring for keyboard navigation, consistent with the rest of the page's minimal styling.
